items.title: App accent tokens fail night mode contrast
items.description: App accent token CSS classes use static hex color definitions across light and night modes. Four of five standalone accent colors fail the 4.5:1 WCAG contrast ratio when rendered on dark surfaces in night mode. Also, white text on the amber accent background fails contrast guidelines in both themes. This violates design system requirements specifying theme-aware contrast ratios.

note.content: In /app/tokens.css (lines 102-106), .ul-root.ul-app-teal, .ul-root.ul-app-amber, .ul-root.ul-app-violet, .ul-root.ul-app-sage, and .ul-root.ul-app-rose define static hex values for --ul-accent and white for --ul-on-accent without theme-dependent overrides for .ul-night, unlike .ul-night.ul-app-ink (lines 100-101).

When rendered on night surface-0 (#0b0b0d, line 45 of /app/tokens.css), teal (#0e7c86) yields 3.98:1, violet (#6d5cf0) yields 4.16:1, sage (#4f7a5a) yields 3.99:1, and rose (#c8243f) yields 3.54:1 contrast ratios. All four fail the WCAG 2.1 AA 4.5:1 minimum threshold.

The amber accent (--ul-accent: #c27a00) with --ul-on-accent: #ffffff (line 103 of /app/tokens.css) yields a contrast ratio of only 3.46:1, failing the 4.5:1 requirement for white foreground text on filled accent buttons in both themes.

/app/DESIGN.md (lines 140, 146) and /app/LANGUAGE.md (lines 34, 39-44) require text to maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast against surfaces in both Light and Night modes, and document theme-specific accent pairs for night themes.

items.title: Forbidden linear gradients and rectangular control shapes
items.description: The showcase CSS contains linear gradients on range sliders and skeleton indicators. Also, copy buttons inside source lines use a four-pixel border radius instead of pill geometry. These implementations violate the explicit Universal Language texture rules that ban gradients on chrome and mandate that all tappable controls use pill shapes.

note.content: /app/showcase.html:L418, L462 — Line 418 uses `linear-gradient` for range slider track filling, and line 462 uses `linear-gradient` for skeleton loading animations.
/app/showcase.html:L438 — Line 438 defines `.src .cp` copy buttons with `border-radius: 4px` instead of pill geometry (`9999px`).

/app/LANGUAGE.md:L19, L23, L83 — Line 19 prohibits gradients on chrome across any platform, line 23 requires pill shapes for tappable controls, and line 83 explicitly specifies pill shape for buttons.
/app/DESIGN.md:L124, L128, L160 — Line 124 prohibits gradients on chrome and surfaces, line 128 mandates `Pill (9999px) = tappable`, and line 160 reinforces `Buttons: pill`.

items.title: Landing page violates CTA and section specifications
items.description: `landing.html` fails CTA layout and section spacing requirements defined in the design specifications. CTA blocks in concepts B and C omit secondary text links with `›` and rely on generic verbs. Section spacing varies across concepts due to inline padding overrides, zero-padding rules, and absent spacing tokens.

note.content: In /app/LANGUAGE.md:L118 and /app/LANGUAGE.md:L120, specifications mandate 140px section spacing. CTA blocks must combine one filled pill with a secondary text link with `›`.
In /app/DESIGN.md:L172, design specifications confirm landing CTA requirements. CTAs combine a filled pill verb button with a secondary text link with `›`.

In /app/landing.html:L140, L145, L155, L159, L164, L174, L178, L183, L193, CTAs use generic labels ('Get the alpha', 'Start a trip', 'Try it free'). Bottom CTAs at L174 and L193 omit the needed secondary text link with `›`.
In /app/landing.html:L35, default section padding is 140px. However, /app/landing.html:L68, L141, L160, L179, L185 override section padding to 0px or 20px, creating uneven section gaps.
In /app/tokens.css:L18-L20, system design tokens define spacing values up to 48px (--ul-space-7) but omit a standard 140px section spacing token for marketing landing pages.

items.title: Micro interaction animations lack state cleanup
items.description: ul.js implements pointer-down squash feedback and SVG logo text write animations using the Web Animation API. The release animation omits persistent state cleanup, which causes element transforms to reset abruptly when animation playback completes. SVG logo text stroke animations also hardcode fixed stroke offsets without measuring dynamic text lengths, causing truncated stroke outlines for variable text content.

note.content: Universal Language specifies uniform press feedback for interactive controls and animated SVG logo write effects in /app/LANGUAGE.md:L105-L107 and /app/DESIGN.md:L168-L170.

In /app/ul.js:L21-L24, the pointerup event listener triggers animation b without fill forwards or style persistence. When animation b completes after 320ms, the Web Animation API removes its keyframe effect, causing abrupt style shifts and visual jumps. The hardcoded 320ms duration in /app/ul.js:L23 also diverges from tokenized spring durations in /app/tokens.css:L27.

In /app/ul.js:L38, the prepare function skips setting pathLength to 1 for SVG text elements. Lines /app/ul.js:L43-L47 and injected CSS at /app/ul.js:L55 fix stroke dash offsets and dash arrays at 120.
Because /app/ul.js:L30-L52 does not measure dynamic text length, logo text strings exceeding 120px path length suffer from incomplete stroke paths and truncated write animations.

items.title: Showcase components lack signature design system patterns
items.description: Key signature components defined in the design specifications fail to match implementation across showcase and CSS tokens. Form controls lack floating field label logic, cards omit mandatory mono source lines, and close controls use custom classes instead of the standardized button token.

note.content: DESIGN.md:L160-L164 and LANGUAGE.md:L89,L111-L112 define specifications for signature components including floating field labels, mono source lines, and standardized close buttons.
tokens.css:L1-L118 defines the central token stylesheet which includes .ul-source at L112, but omits CSS rules for .field floating labels and .xbtn close buttons.
showcase.html:L386-L398 defines form controls using a static label element above a plain input element instead of floating label markup.
showcase.html:L435-L439, L756-L762, and L789 use a custom .src class rather than .ul-source, and omit source lines on map and quest cards.
showcase.html:L183, L307-L312, and L905 define close buttons using non-standard .x classes with 28px dimensions rather than the standardized 32px .xbtn circle token.

items.title: Showcase interactive controls fail target size specifications
items.description: Interactive elements in showcase.html fall below minimum target size specifications established across design families. Fixed-size controls including switcher buttons and copy buttons fail touch standards, while relative formulas systematically reduce small buttons, chips, and segmented controls below target thresholds. Root variable declarations further diverge from token defaults, creating misclick hazards across touch and pointer viewports.

note.content: /app/DESIGN.md:L113-L115, /app/DESIGN.md:L142-L146, and /app/LANGUAGE.md:L39-L44 define target size standards: 34px for Developer (.ul-family-dev), 40px for Travel (.ul-family-travel), 48px for Kids (.ul-family-kids), and 44px default roomy target.
/app/tokens.css:L21, /app/tokens.css:L79, /app/tokens.css:L88, and /app/tokens.css:L97 specify CSS target tokens for default (44px), compact Developer (34px), Travel (40px), and Kids (48px) families.

/app/showcase.html:L337-L339 sets top bar switcher buttons (.pseg button) to 27px height, and /app/showcase.html:L438-L439 sets copy buttons (.src .cp) to 17px height, failing all minimum target size standards.

/app/showcase.html:L152, /app/showcase.html:L180, /app/showcase.html:L237, /app/showcase.html:L372, /app/showcase.html:L380, and /app/showcase.html:L415 define controls using fixed heights (26px pin buttons, 34px topnav and Beacon buttons) or subtractions like calc(var(--ul-target) - 8px) and calc(var(--ul-target) - 6px), forcing controls below family target thresholds.
/app/showcase.html:L19 hardcodes --ul-target: 36px on .ul-root, diverging from the 44px default defined in /app/tokens.css:L21 and /app/DESIGN.md:L113.
